text: The app is dead and abandoned by the developer who denies it but still not showing intention to progress. Nothing added or fixed for the last two years. Started okay but ended up procrastinating again because of the stagnation on the app. Better off using Habitica.
author: Kavatzogata
developer_reply: Hello, we'are not abandoned, app is still being updated regularly and monitoring. Keep up with good work.
